links.comparator_used: Alternative cutpoint selection approaches that optimize test-specific or purely statistical metrics (e.g., sensitivity/specificity-based methods), compared via Monte Carlo simulation of net monetary benefit
links.outcome: Expected net monetary benefit (NMB) of model-guided decisions for ICU readmission prevention and inpatient falls prevention
links.effect: The value-optimizing cutpoint approach was frequently NMB-maximizing; under realistic low-prevalence, modest-discrimination scenarios (ICU: prevalence 0.025, AUC 0.70; falls: prevalence 0.036, AUC 0.70) it was either the best or similar to the best of the compared methods, and was robust to model miscalibration. No numeric NMB values reported in the abstract.
links.quote: The proposed approach that considered expected downstream consequences was frequently NMB-maximizing compared with other methods.

design_hint: alert threshold (cutpoint) selection using net monetary benefit
